terms.definition: The released signed WBM distance to a fixed historical MP hull is <=0.05 eV/atom. This is a retrospective label, not a new DFT result.
terms.label: Historical near-stable

terms.definition: A released signed historical hull distance <=0. Negative signed values are preserved rather than clipped to zero.
terms.label: On/below the historical reference hull

terms.definition: The recorded interval half-width is q times max(ensemble disagreement, 0.01 eV/atom), using the frozen calibration procedure. Empirical coverage is evaluated separately.
terms.label: Calibration radius

terms.definition: Sample standard deviation of the five member predictions. It can rank error without guaranteeing calibrated intervals under arbitrary distribution shift.
terms.label: Ensemble disagreement

terms.definition: Eligibility includes the requested expanded atom counts in the actual executed cell. The gate is a protocol/workload condition, not a physical stability label.
terms.label: Exact-cell validity

terms.definition: A valid structure remaining after the protocol's tolerant structural deduplication. Multiple valid draws can collapse to one unique representative.
terms.label: Unique structure

terms.definition: A saved structure meets the stated model/optimizer convergence criterion. Its model energy is not a fresh QE energy or a thermodynamic hull distance.
terms.label: CHGNet relaxed

terms.definition: Electronic/geometry acceptance and compatible finite sensitivity checks are separate from process completion. Accepted static calculations alone do not establish competition-hull or phonon stability.
terms.label: Fresh DFT validation

terms.definition: Accepted source-reference IDs divided by the retained inventory memberships for the stated chemical system. A generated control does not add another source reference ID.
terms.label: Reference coverage

terms.definition: A predeclared known-template substitution baseline, distinct from transformer-generated outputs. A converged baseline is not automatically stable or globally novel.
terms.label: Prototype substitution

terms.definition: The predictor withholds complete chemical systems within each split. This does not prove that generator pretraining excludes those compositions or establish universal OOD performance.
terms.label: Out-of-distribution scope

terms.definition: A generated/relaxed control matches a named known phase. Reproducing it validates a workflow without establishing discovery of a new material.
terms.label: Known-phase recovery
